description: Return a slice of rows from a Parquet file (default 20, max 500), optionally only some columns, as JSON rows, a Markdown table, or CSV. Use to eyeball data; use query_parquet to filter or aggregate. Long cells are truncated. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call, paid via x402.

format.description: json rows (default), a Markdown table, or CSV text.

url.title: Url

name: preview_parquet

truncated.description: True when more rows matched than were returned.
